# Advertising and manufactured wants

A standard worry: if producers create the wants they then satisfy, the usual defence of production (it serves demand) goes in a circle.

## How a want is made

Advertising rarely argues that a product is useful. It shows a model, somebody enviable, already wanting and having the thing. The viewer is offered a desire to imitate rather than a reason. This is [[Mimetic desire]] run as an industry.

## Status

Many manufactured wants are for [[Positional goods]]: things valued because others cannot have them. Supply cannot satisfy this kind of demand, since more supply destroys the value.
